item.title: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: AWS now allows vibe coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step towards decoupling apps from models.

item.title: DesignArena creators raise $7.9 million to bring taste to AI models
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom

item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: OpenAI’s first-ever influencer brand trip is sparking online backlash as tensions over the use of AI continue.

item.title: Apple finally fixed Siri. So why does it feel anticlimactic?
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Apple’s long-awaited AI overhaul finally makes Siri the assistant it was always supposed to be. But after years of delays, the launch lands in an AI landscape where chatbots have evolved into agents that can code, reason, create media, and complete complex tasks. Siri AI is genuinely useful, yet it arrives at a moment when simply being a capable AI assistant no longer feels revolutionary.

item.title: Congress’ favorite AI tool? ChatGPT
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: House spending records show OpenAI's ChatGPT dominates paid AI use on Capitol Hill, with congressional offices relying on the chatbot to draft memos, summarize legislation, and assist constituent communications.

item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz

item.title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: Green offered a remarkable apology, saying that "the level of dopamine that I've been getting from interacting with LLMs ... is not healthy for me or good for the world."
